newsitem.title: USA: Tel Offshore to be delisted from Nasdaq.
newsitem.headline: Tel Offshore to be delisted from Nasdaq.

text.p: Tel Offshore Trust said its units are scheduled to be delisted from the Nasdaq SmallCap Market because the trust no longer meets the total asset requirement.
The trust said it is seeking a waiver of the total asset requirement, but no assurance can be given that a waiver will be given.
A hearing on the waiver is expected in the second week of October. If the units were delisted, they would be eligible for trading on the OTC Bulletin Board, the company said.
